correctness.rationale: The independent-digit mask factorization and b-adic scaling are exact. The identity (d+1)^2-|sum z_i|^2=sum unequal chord squares, combined with at least d unequal pairs and minimal chord 2 sin(pi/N), gives the pointwise optimal majorant. Positive product convergence and fine-scale equality force exactly the axis or diagonal primitive frequencies. Fourier multiplier diagonalization yields the L2 statement. The separately executable code tests finite cases but does not replace the proof.
